node.title: Official FPC5 prefixes paid by GRS support shortening
node.statement: At n=8192, apply the exact constant-weight shortening cap to every PF6 cell and compile it through canonical first-layout domination. At rate 1/8, the complete residual source-scale prefix M=29,...,32 has total cap 195112047344632914122867933361797765038 and is paid for q at least 2^128 times that integer, a nonempty 256-bit field slice. At rate 1/16, the complete prefix M=57,...,67 has total cap 2444555448501019158442942184801171570 and is paid from a 249-bit field threshold. The same cap fails at the strict field maximum for rate 1/2 M=5, rate 1/4 M=13, rate 1/8 M=33, and rate 1/16 M=68; these are route fences, not lower bounds.
